title: Cut: simplification, on feature/simplification
situation: 0142 to 0144 change how agents are evaluated and enforced and what this repository tests; 0124 proposed holding the architect's replies by a structured, checked report act.
decision: One cut on feature branch feature/simplification, across workflow and agents, held by the architect: realize 0142 to 0144 by deletion first; supersede example, freeze and roles to remove what leaked from the other domains, retire never-assertion and offline proof, and supersede enforcement-level, drift, reach and binding. 0124 is withdrawn: the architect's replies are held by its own text and judged in use, revisited only if use shows drift persisting. The cut is checked by the deterministic suite and reviewed by reading; no live run.
consequences: Ahead of the contracts cut. Its examples are retirements, stated as absences, and the few behaviours that remain, stated as warnings rather than refusals.
